examples.review_text: Attention Android Users: unfortunately, there are better alternatives to this app. What's wrong with it? * Shuffle will very frequently NOT work, prompting you to restart the application. Shuffle will also frequently replay songs that you've already heard on a playlist. * "Skip Forward 15 seconds" - this feature only works if you have the app OPEN and are LOOKING at the screen. Otherwise, if you just double tap a bluetooth earbud, it'll skip 5 seconds at a time. Insanity. * Podcasts: as a premium user, it is UNACCEPTABLE to be forced to listen through advertisements, which are often unskippable. Unacceptable. The "skip ahead 15 seconds" feature FREQUENTLY stops working during ads... How convenient. * Further Bugs - the program simply is not optimized to be run on Windows or on Android. It's clear that Spotify was made on Apple, by Apple devices, FOR Apple devices. Which is weird, because Apple Music is a better service. Until Spotify addresses these issues, I cannot recommend the app. It isn't ready yet. Maybe in a couple years when the developers decide it's worth investing in Android devices, it'll be at a more stable, usable place. But until then, I recommend you download music files to your phone and use some music player to play them, instead. Spotify is lower bandwidth/bitrate than you'd get supplying your own music files, you won't have to deal with advertisements, and you also won't have to deal with the application absolutely shutting down and malfunctioning every time you change cell towers/wifi connections/bluetooth connections. Spotify just is not worth it. This is as lazy as a mainstream product could possibly be. Engineered enough to just barely work.
